name: Sylvie
source:
Mage Trainee

Sylvie has long dreamed of becoming a powerful mage and going on adventures just like her father did in his youth.
Trained by him from an early age in physical combat, he prevented her from even learning the fundamentals of magic until she ws able to prove to him that she was able to handle herself in a fistfight.

When not making up for lost time in her magic studies, Sylvie is most often found goofing off with her best friend Nicolette. While their personalities and interests may be polar opposites, the two of them are inseparable. 

That doesn't stop her from getting punchy when Nicolette goes overboard with her teasing, though.
